Slots

A component declares slots as $-props; the caller fills them with $ elements.

<Button size="lg">
  <$Icon { size }><Plus size /></$Icon>
  <$Label>Save</$Label>
</Button>

A slot's props replace the attachment's, prop by prop; the attachment's children are the fallback.
